invocation: <venv>/python harvest.py <out_dir> green_valley mason (run from the Python prototype root, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1); compact.py splits the dumps per stage

changes: helix.mode: memory, namespace p8_<scenario> (one database per scenario)

models.embeddings: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 via sentence-transformers (cpu); vectors not stored

notes: documents of a scenario run in order against one store, so ED reuses entities across documents
helix_id / chunk_id / entity ids are the Python in-memory store's sequential ids
detector_raw is each detector's output per chunk (segment_id <doc_id>_<sequence_number>) before stage-level filtering, healing and merging
raw_coref is the fastcoref output (CorefOutput) the coreference stage post-processed

extra.invocation: <venv>/python harvest_a.py <impeach fixtures dir> <out_dir> (run from the Python prototype root, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1)

outputs.definition_extraction/documents.json: RAGIndex + Mention (eyecite, regex, GLiNER2) + Definition stages of processing_v17 over extra documents (transcripts, ingest samples, contradiction_test scenarios)
outputs.definition_extraction/cases.json: definition extractor with the shipped roles.yaml over hand-written texts and mentions
outputs.mention_detection/detector_cases.json: raw citation (eyecite) and regex detector output per text
